# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Bill  <sub>[v3 c8 P14](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man with a round face completely devoid of expression. He is characterized by a tendency to smirk and laugh softly while struggling to form answers in conversation.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Barney is an emotionless, extremely bashful, and quiet individual who possesses very little capacity for chatter or conversation. Despite his awkwardness, he is a hard-working, dependable, and kindly man who lacks any negative vices. He harbors a deep, enduring admiration for Nell Harcourt.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Traits

- Inability to hold a conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- Bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Dependable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen escorted Nell Harcourt to a concert at Pale Sands, driving her on the front seat of his buggy and taking immense pride in her presence despite his difficulty maintaining a conversation. Having harbored an infatuation for Nell, he was later gifted the upper farm in his own name by his father. Due to his extreme shyness, he persuaded his sister Odette to propose marriage to Nell on his behalf, offering to wait until she completed her college education if necessary. Nell rejected the proposal, as she had never considered him as a romantic prospect.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P14](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0014), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)_
